I've answered Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is for 185 seats.

That number comes from #north-team, a channel she's in. On 20 Aug 2025 she posted 180 seats for the amendment, which was signed 19 Aug. A few minutes later she corrected it to 185.

I couldn't see the amendment itself, so the figure isn't checked against the signed copy. I told her June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if the QBR deck needs to match it exactly.
